author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Tender lamb, creamy potatoes, and the smoky warmth of a wood-fired oven come together in this comforting shepherd’s pie 🥩🔥 In this video, we prepare a hearty rustic meal using simple ingredients and traditional village cooking methods.

The flavorful lamb filling is covered with a generous layer of soft mashed potatoes, then slowly baked in the wood-fired oven until beautifully golden on top. The fire adds a subtle smoky aroma while keeping the filling rich, juicy, and satisfying.

Lamb shepherd’s pie is a classic comfort food made even more special with rustic wood-fired cooking. Hearty meat, creamy potatoes, and the warmth of the fire create a wholesome homemade meal perfect for sharing with family. 🌿🥔🔥
title: Wood-Fired Lamb Shepherd’s Pie | Rustic Village Cooking 🥩🔥
